'''''Verisimilitude''''' was a trade holo for the [[Holodrama/Legends|holofilm]] industry. It reported that studios were willing to pay up to 125 million [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for the rights to the [[Aris-Del Wari|Baby Ludi]] story.
